fieldValues.policy_explanation: Find out before changing behaviour: reproduce the problem, write a failing test, spike it, or write the missing technical plan or placement as a proposal. A probe is real work; it is how the next run reaches a higher mode.
care_must: change no behaviour that merges without the owner
leave a written result: a reproduction, test, spike or proposal
suggest a placement or technical plan for the item
